pick.note: High-confidence pick - full write-up on the Predictions page

events.pred: Australia's women have been too strong for New Zealand all week and the series evidence is one-sided. Ellyse Perry's 52 anchored a two-wicket chase in the opener, then Ashleigh Gardner's 84 from 45 balls powered a 40-run win that retained the Rose Bowl with a game to spare. With the hosts 2-0 up and the middle order in form, the selection is Australia Women to complete the sweep at North Sydney Oval.
facts: Australia W won the 1st T20I by 2 wickets (Perry 52) and the 2nd by 40 runs (Gardner 84 off 45); series 2-0, Rose Bowl retained
